![](images/8d/8d83a591169c9ac41f6637a985554b0b907fa017349bf92c9197618a3f61409b.png)" :question/worked-solution "First, we find $r'(t)$ and $\|r'(t)\|:$

$$
\begin{aligned}r'(t)&=\left\langle\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(4 t + 2),\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(- \frac{\left(2 t + 1\right)^{3}}{3} - \frac{1}{2 t + 1})\right\rangle \\ &=\left\langle 4,- 2 \left(2 t + 1\right)^{2} + \frac{2}{\left(2 t + 1\right)^{2}}\right\rangle \\ \|r'(t)\|&=\sqrt{(4)^2+(- 2 \left(2 t + 1\right)^{2} + \frac{2}{\left(2 t + 1\right)^{2}})^2} \\ &=2\sqrt{4+\left(\frac{1}{(2 t + 1)^2}-(2 t + 1)^2\right)^2} \\ &=2\sqrt{4+\frac{1}{(2 t + 1)^4}-2+(2 t + 1)^4} \\ &=2\sqrt{\frac{1}{(2 t + 1)^4}+2+(2 t + 1)^4} \\ &=2\sqrt{\left(\frac{1}{(2 t + 1)^2}+(2 t + 1)^2\right)^2} \\ &=2 \left(2 t + 1\right)^{2} + \frac{2}{\left(2 t + 1\right)^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that $2 t + 1>0$ throughout the given interval.

We can solve this using the substitution $u=2 t + 1$, $\mathrm{d}u=2\mathrm{d}t$.

Therefore, the arc length of the curve is

$$
\begin{aligned}L&=\int_{0}^{1}2 \left(2 t + 1\right)^{2} + \frac{2}{\left(2 t + 1\right)^{2}}\,\mathrm{d}t \\ &=\int_{1}^{3}u^{2} + \frac{1}{u^{2}}\,\mathrm{d}u \\ &=\frac{u^{3}}{3} - \frac{1}{u}\big|_{1}^{3} \\ &=1\left[\left(-\frac{1}{3}+\frac{3^3}{3}\right)-\left(-\frac{1}{1}+\frac{1^3}{3}\right)\right] \\ &=\frac{28}{3}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["13577cdf-f8b5-5512-884e-ecd8f2676e0d"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "402af249-7f17-5997-9c72-8726a45d2b0f" :answer/id #uuid "402af249-7f17-5997-9c72-8726a45d2b0f" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{393}{20}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "89913d7f-56a6-5fa1-8909-5022b2fa3801" :answer/id #uuid "89913d7f-56a6-5fa1-8909-5022b2fa3801" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{1873917}{1000}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "0df58327-4c7b-56a6-a555-7f93859ea5c3" :answer/id #uuid "0df58327-4c7b-56a6-a555-7f93859ea5c3" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3 \sqrt{17041}}{10}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "99c54e4c-1cdd-56bc-b87f-085bc3821f2e" :answer/id #uuid "99c54e4c-1cdd-56bc-b87f-085bc3821f2e" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{393}{10}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "194cc645-b463-5b8e-b9e5-27852c3d7f61" :answer/id #uuid "194cc645-b463-5b8e-b9e5-27852c3d7f61" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{393}{5}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "f7c29cac-8af6-5168-a467-de45c5d34de2" :answer-field/id #uuid "f7c29cac-8af6-5168-a467-de45c5d34de2" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["402af249-7f17-5997-9c72-8726a45d2b0f" "89913d7f-56a6-5fa1-8909-5022b2fa3801" "0df58327-4c7b-56a6-a555-7f93859ea5c3" "99c54e4c-1cdd-56bc-b87f-085bc3821f2e" "194cc645-b463-5b8e-b9e5-27852c3d7f61"] :answer-field/correct "99c54e4c-1cdd-56bc-b87f-085bc3821f2e" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "04a33944-3b1f-5a14-b50e-bd7ec0252827" :question/id #uuid "04a33944-3b1f-5a14-b50e-bd7ec0252827" :question/problem "Find the arc length of the curve $r(t)=\langle 6 t + 4,- \frac{\left(3 t + 2\right)^{3}}{3} - \frac{1}{3 t + 2}\rangle$ from $t=0$ to $t=1$.

![](images/db/db3e582e3cbf491015aa1f08ac77ddb6b02b2a8143bebc2d76d171ebd64f9570.png)" :question/worked-solution "First, we find $r'(t)$ and $\|r'(t)\|:$

$$
\begin{aligned}r'(t)&=\left\langle\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(6 t + 4),\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(- \frac{\left(3 t + 2\right)^{3}}{3} - \frac{1}{3 t + 2})\right\rangle \\ &=\left\langle 6,- 3 \left(3 t + 2\right)^{2} + \frac{3}{\left(3 t + 2\right)^{2}}\right\rangle \\ \|r'(t)\|&=\sqrt{(6)^2+(- 3 \left(3 t + 2\right)^{2} + \frac{3}{\left(3 t + 2\right)^{2}})^2} \\ &=3\sqrt{4+\left(\frac{1}{(3 t + 2)^2}-(3 t + 2)^2\right)^2} \\ &=3\sqrt{4+\frac{1}{(3 t + 2)^4}-2+(3 t + 2)^4} \\ &=3\sqrt{\frac{1}{(3 t + 2)^4}+2+(3 t + 2)^4} \\ &=3\sqrt{\left(\frac{1}{(3 t + 2)^2}+(3 t + 2)^2\right)^2} \\ &=3 \left(3 t + 2\right)^{2} + \frac{3}{\left(3 t + 2\right)^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that $3 t + 2>0$ throughout the given interval.

We can solve this using the substitution $u=3 t + 2$, $\mathrm{d}u=3\mathrm{d}t$.

Therefore, the arc length of the curve is
